user.title: Spatial Context
user.description: Trace each floor's layout and place your devices on it, so an AI assistant can be given real physical context for your home.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Spatial Context is already set up.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Returns the full spatial context map, including floors, rooms, walls, and devices.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Only this floor (floor ID or name).

room.name: Room
room.description: Only this room (room ID or name). Walls are left out.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: Round to 0.1 m and 1 dB, and leave out editor units and repeated labels.

include_links.name: Include links
include_links.description: Add the radio links between the exported devices, with distance, walls and predicted and measured signal.

query.name: Query the spatial engine
query.description: Returns one of the AI outputs (the same as the LLM tools): a home summary, one device's context, the path between two devices, weak links, or one room.

tool.name: Tool
tool.description: Which output: summary, device_context, path, weak_links or room.

device.name: Device
device.description: For device_context: device ID, short ID (d12) or name.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: For weak_links: only this radio layer.

level.name: Level
level.description: For weak_links: only links touching this level (floor ID, short ID or name).

room.name: Room
room.description: For room: room ID, short ID (r3) or name.

update_settings.name: Update AI and RF settings
update_settings.description: Changes the settings the panel has no controls for yet. Fields left out keep their value.

llm_tools_enabled.name: LLM tools
llm_tools_enabled.description: Offer the spatial tools to conversation agents using the Home Assistant LLM API.

floor_height_m.name: Floor height
floor_height_m.description: Height of one level, for distances between floors.

rf_path_loss_exponent.name: Path-loss exponent
rf_path_loss_exponent.description: 2.0 is free space; indoor paths are often 2.5 to 3.5.

rf_slab_loss_db.name: Floor loss
rf_slab_loss_db.description: Signal loss through one floor slab.

weak_link_threshold_db.name: Weak-link threshold
weak_link_threshold_db.description: How many dB worse than predicted before a link counts as weak. 0 turns the check off.

refresh_zigbee_mesh.name: Refresh Zigbee mesh
refresh_zigbee_mesh.description: Forces a fresh Zigbee2MQTT network scan and caches the result, so the panel's own "Load Mesh" can serve it instantly. Intended for a scheduled/overnight automation, not interactive use (a scan can take 1–2 minutes).

refresh_links.name: Refresh radio links
refresh_links.description: Re-reads the radio links (ZHA, Zigbee2MQTT, Matter/Thread, UniFi Wi-Fi) into Spatial Context's link store. Cheap; it reads what the integrations already hold and never starts a Zigbee scan, except a first Zigbee2MQTT network map when none has been fetched yet. Runs by itself every 30 minutes.

layers.name: Layers
layers.description: Only refresh these layers. Leave empty for all.
